youtube_title: LaPorte's wildest Halloween weather: 2.98" of rain, a 67 mph gust and snow
youtube:
Think Halloween weather can't get wild around LaPorte, Indiana? The records say otherwise. 🎃 In 2013, a storm soaked Halloween night: one LaPorte gauge caught 2.98 inches of rain, and Fort Wayne had its wettest Halloween on record. In 2014, a gust hit 67 mph over Lake Michigan off Michigan City, and waves out in the middle of the lake topped 21 feet. In 2019, 2.2 inches of snow fell near Valparaiso on Chicago's snowiest Halloween ever. In 2023, South Bend got 1.4 inches of snow, its second-snowiest Halloween, behind a record 1.6 inches in the 1950s. And the coldest? 1917, when South Bend's high was 35. What's the wildest Halloween you remember? Tell us in the comments! Saturday's trick-or-treat forecast: https://laporteweathernow.com #LaPorte #Halloween #Indiana #Weather #MichiganCity #SouthBend #Shorts

All pictures are drawn. Narration is a computer voice. Sources: NWS Northern Indiana, Halloween 2013 rainfall (weather.gov/iwx/20131031_rain); NWS Chicago, Oct. 31, 2014 wind and waves (weather.gov/lot/2014Oct31) and Oct. 30-31, 2019 snow (weather.gov/lot/3031Oct2019_snow); ABC57 (Oct. 31, 2014; Oct. 31, 2024); CBS Chicago (2019); WSBT and WISH-TV (South Bend Halloween records); WANE (Fort Wayne). The 1.6-inch record is dated 1956 by WSBT and 1954 by ABC57, so we say "the 1950s."
